title: Leveraging Implicit Sentiments: Enhancing Reliability and Validity in Psychological Trait Evaluation of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Adapting the Implicit Association Test (IAT) into a Core Sentiment Inventory (CSI) where LLMs are prompted to associate 5,000 neutral words (nouns and verbs) with opposing concepts like 'comedy' or 'tragedy' to measure their baseline optimism, pessimism, and neutrality towards everyday concepts.

Comparing the model's implicit sentiment tendencies and scores (optimism, pessimism, neutrality) when prompted in English versus Chinese to identify cross-lingual discrepancies in emotional expressions.
